speaker: Vale
voiceIdRequirement: Supply an observed Sarah voice ID with --voice-id. The v2 evidence did not expose an ID; do not guess it.
purpose: Correct acronym pronunciation using sentence-case words, preserving the existing speaker and radio treatment. Audition is required; spelling alone is not proof of correct pronunciation.

processing.resampling: Same 129-tap windowed-sinc anti-alias filter and exact 2:1 decimation as prepare-radio-v2.py; average stereo channels first.
processing.runtimeTrim: Unchanged; do not apply the existing -6dB radio trim again during processing.

safety.default: Dry run: no credential access, network call, or asset writes.
safety.live: One explicit --generate --cue=<cue> --voice-id=<observed Sarah ID> per invocation, only after owner go-ahead and credit review.
safety.originals: Never overwrite v2 sources, WAV files, provenance, or runtime mappings.
safety.retry: Skip any existing v3 output, request receipt, or success receipt. A request-started receipt is written before HTTP. An uncertain outcome requires manual provider-history review, never an automatic retry.
safety.review: Generated is not approved. Decode, audition each entire clip against the phrase and Sarah v2, check loudness/subtitles, then separately authorize runtime mapping.
